contact.heading: Get in touch
contact.intro: Email is the most reliable way to reach me — for questions about the research on this site, corrections, or collaboration on something in the same territory.
contact.privacyNote: I keep personal details off this site on purpose. I don't publish my location beyond the state, my phone number, or anything about where I study. Please don't send private or sensitive information over email either — treat anything you send as ordinary, unencrypted mail.
contact.responseNote: I'm a student, so replies can be slow. If a message goes unanswered it's time, not disinterest.
contact.corrections: If you think something here is wrong, tell me what and why, ideally with a source. Corrections are the most useful mail I get.
